en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a small industrial town set among rocky hills. In the middle distance are factory buildings with tall chimneys emitting smoke, surrounded by dense low-rise housing blocks. In the foreground there is a treed rocky outcrop and below it an open sports field or park bordered by a tree-lined street. At the top of the postcard, printed text reads "Uddevalla. Idrottsplanen." indicating the town and the sports ground.
